name: ContributionMessageType
description: What kind of message sits on a contribution. MODERATOR is an access rule, not a display hint: a query serving a member must filter it out.

values.name: HISTORY
values.description: Written by the system when the contribution changed, not by a person.

values.name: DIALOG
values.description: The exchange between member and moderator. Visible to both.

values.name: MODERATOR
values.description: Moderator-to-moderator. Never leaves the moderator view.
